findings.claim: The new 'Normalized-character figures ... stale by the <title> length' Debt row was appended onto the PR #28 R4/R5 row's line with no newline, so it is not a row in the Debt table at all: tasks/TODO.md line 103 is one 7-cell line in a 3-column table (cells 3..6 are the new row), and a Markdown renderer truncates/garbles it.
findings.evidence: tasks/TODO.md:103 — '...take them with the R2/R3 one-liners in the next ledger pass || **Normalized-character figures in the benchmark artifact of record...'; the diff hunk (`-` line ends 'ledger pass |', `+` line continues '| **Normalized...') shows this PR introduced it. Splitting line 103 on '|' yields 7 cells (header at :56 has 3); the vacuous_coverage row at :104 is correctly 3 cells.
findings.repro: awk 'NR==103{print gsub(/\|/,"|")-1}' tasks/TODO.md  -> 7 ; sed -n 103p tasks/TODO.md | grep -o '.\{40\}|| \*\*Normalized'
findings.acceptance: tasks/TODO.md:103 ends at '...next ledger pass |' and the Normalized-character Debt row is its own 3-cell line; every Debt-table row has exactly 3 cells except the pre-existing :84/:89/:96 defects this PR did not touch.

findings.claim: T3-2 is fixed with no case in the gate suites: the only pin is a normalize._demo assert, so the eval gate (invariant 40/40, fast 82/82) cannot see AMENDMENT_RE at all — removing the new branch leaves both suites green — which is neither 'fix-with-case' nor 'debt' under criterion 1 / hard rule 2, and ADR-024 does not cover it: §2's _demo exemption is for 'a behaviour no fixture can carry', but a 10-K/A cover is trivially carried by a synthetic fixture (this same PR synthesizes comma-cover-2016 by one byte, and ksb-2007/aapl-2026-10q already are committed fixtures of refused forms), and §3 — cited for 'no fixture' — says in the same sentence 'no new code path', which the PR adds.
findings.evidence: src/sec10k/normalize.py:37-38, :199-201 (new AMENDMENT_RE branch); the only red/green is src/sec10k/normalize.py:_demo :217-220 (CI unit-tests job runs it; the Gate in CLAUDE.md does not). Measured: no committed or held-out fixture has /amendment\s+no/i in text[:6000] (43 fixtures, zero hits), so no gate case exercises the branch; form_type_sniffed is unchanged on all 43 at HEAD (author's claim confirmed). specs/decisions/ADR-024-10ka-out-of-scope.md Decision §2 ('a behaviour no fixture can carry is proved at the layer'), §3 ('No new fixture, no new code path').
findings.repro: python3 -m evals.run --suite invariant && python3 -m evals.run --suite fast with AMENDMENT_RE.search monkeypatched to return None (or the `if not form.endswith...` block deleted): both stay 40/40 and 82/82. Only `python3 -m src.sec10k.normalize` goes red.
findings.acceptance: Either an adversarial case in the fast+invariant suites (e.g. a one-line synthetic cover copy with '(Amendment No. 1)' typeset below 'FORM 10-K', asserting doc_status unsupported / unsupported_form, watched red at 3c2b8f4), or T3-2 moved to the Debt table with the honest reason; if the _demo-only route is kept, an ADR amendment stating that _demo is an accepted disposition for gate-invisible fixes — not a selective citation of ADR-024 §3.

findings.claim: Edge shapes of the title skip: an unclosed <title> now swallows the whole document (html.parser treats title as RCDATA on 3.11 and 3.14, skip_depth never returns to 0) -> 0 chars -> failed/normalization_collapse, where main emitted tag soup; <noscript> text inside <head> still leaks; self-closing <title/>, uppercase <TITLE>, entities and nested tags in the title all behave. No committed or held-out fixture has a <title> outside <head>, an unclosed one, <noscript> or <textarea> (34 fixtures have exactly one open/one close, all before <body>).
findings.evidence: select_and_normalize('x<meta charset=x></head><body><p>FORM 10-K</p>...') -> '' on both python3.11 and 3.14.6; '<noscript>JS OFF TEXT</noscript>' in head -> 'JS OFF TEXT\n\nFORM 10-K'.
findings.acceptance: Noted (debt or comment) or left as-is; a loud `failed` on a document a browser would also render blank is defensible.
